name: Roller Shutters
tagline: Extruded shutter slat, guides and operators as one set
blurb: Slat is rolled from 6063-T5 and 6063-T6 strip and powder coated on the automatic line, in gauges from 0.8 mm for a domestic opening to 2.5 mm for a 10.5 m industrial span. A shutter is quoted as a set — slat, guide, latch, operator and battery back-up — because the operator is sized against the weight of the curtain it is fitted to, not against the size of the hole in the wall.
